## Purpose & Scope
MinesQuiz is an automated statutory assessment platform designed to prepare candidates for statutory mining examinations governed by the Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS). The platform delivers high-fidelity computer-based assessments replicating official examination patterns while maintaining exam integrity through client-side AI proctoring.

## Scoring Model & Statutory Standards
* Total Questions per Assessment: 30 Questions
* Score Value per Question: +1.0 Mark
* Negative Marking Policy: Zero negative marking (0 penalty for incorrect or blank answers)
* Statutory Pass Mark: 60.0% Minimum (18 of 30 correct answers)
* Exam Duration: 60 Minutes (with automatic submission countdown)

## Security Architecture & Anti-Cheat Protocols
1. Anti-Tamper Question Delivery: Questions delivered to the browser runtime contain only question text and shuffled option choices. Correct answer keys (correctOptionIds) are never exposed to client-side memory or DOM elements.
2. AI Proctoring:
   - MediaPipe FaceMesh model computes 468 3D landmarks at 30 FPS inside the browser.
   - Gaze estimation tracks yaw, pitch, and roll. Turns exceeding 35 degrees trigger a strike.
   - Ambient audio analyzer checks for human speech or high-decibel background noise (>0.35 RMS).
   - Window focus and fullscreen enforcement detect tab switching or second-monitor usage.
3. Single Attempt Governance: Candidate attempts are hashed and permanently registered in local storage and server records to prevent duplicate retakes of official examinations.

## Mining Statutory Question Papers
* MIN-101: Mining Legislation, CMR 2017, Mines Act 1952, DGMS Circulars, Statutory Duties of Mine Managers, Overmen, Sirdars, Surveyors, and Competent Persons.
* MIN-102: Mine Ventilation, Gases Detection, Flame Safety Lamps, Methanometers, Air Crossing, Auxiliary Fans, Dust Suppression, and Spontaneous Combustion.
* MIN-103: Winning and Working, Underground Development, Bord and Pillar, Longwall Mining, Open Cast Equipment, Blasting Physics, Explosives Regulations.
* MIN-104: Mine Surveying, Correlation Surveys, Triangulation, Strata Control, Subsidence Engineering, Geotechnical Slope Stability.
